title: OpenAI API error: "Module 'openai' has no attribute 'ChatCompletion', did you mean 'Completion'?"

steps.original_code:
import os
import openai
openai.api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")

completion = openai.ChatCompletion.create(
  model = "gpt-4",
  messages = [
    {"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant."},
    {"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}
  ]
)

print(completion.choices[0].message)
steps.final_code:
import os
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(api_key=os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"))

completion = client.chat.completions.create(
  model="gpt-4",
  messages=[
    {"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant."},
    {"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}
  ]
)

print(completion.choices[0].message)
steps.label: broken
steps.reason:
APIRemovedInV1: 

You tried to access openai.ChatCompletion, but this is no longer supported in openai>=1.0.0 - see the README at https://github.com/openai/openai-python for the API.

You can run `openai migrate` to automatically upgrade your codebase to use the 1.0.0 interface. 

Alternatively, you can pin your installation to the old version, e.g. `pip install openai==0.28`

A detailed migration guide is available here: https://github.com/openai/openai-python/discussions/742

repair_attempts.explanation: The installed openai package is 3.58.0, which removes the legacy openai.ChatCompletion namespace. The code is updated to the v1.x client interface: instantiate an OpenAI client and call client.chat.completions.create(...). The API key is passed to the client constructor (it is also read automatically from the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable).
